title: Measure the residual of the learned approximation with positive probes
statement: For the actual common physical purification Psi_x=sum_i |i>G_i x, frozen learned directions define discarded mass Lambda and retained row residual S. Fresh coordinate probes have Bernoulli means Lambda/4 and S/(3d). Their one-sided tests and a fresh actual anchor bank control root risk uniformly over the encoder family and every coherent CPTP decoder, without pinching the payload or assuming the pilot was correct.

requires: Stationary/reset physical source, known k-dimensional receiver basis and fixed four-real-coordinate isometric encoder family
Actual ordinary six-state loss preparation, fresh pilot/validation/anchor/fallback chronology and finite physical full-CPTP optimization/control
All worst-case call/control/bit caps and whole-process/predecision-record implementation allowances fixed before data
provides: A selective task-approximation certificate sound for arbitrary row ranks
assumptions: The compatible linear purification comes from actual preparation, not arbitrary positive matrix-polynomial fitting
False-acceptance mass is unconditional, not posterior confidence after rare acceptance
The source resets; frame memory and source memory are different interfaces
costs: Generic deterministic cap O_tilde(k^4/(gamma epsilon)); well-balanced exact-row high-probability actual bill O_tilde((d+dr)/(kappa_* gamma epsilon))
Paid collective quantum bank, classical rational anchor search, up to 3d learned kernel settings per stage, one actual accepted anchor bank and fresh fallback calls
